name: 마커스
motion_summary: Eternal Return Markus Earthquake: muscular dark short-haired warrior, stern dark eyes, beard/stubble and rugged black/metal armour, massive broad axe per exact identity. R leaps and SLAMS AXE to create a trapezoid fissured ground effect. Frames: ready; plant feet and lower body; lift axe behind head; jump with knees tucked; airborne axe overhead; body drops with hands driving axe down; axe blade impacts ground; compact orange-gold rock fissure spreads forward-right; ground fragments pop upward and settle while he holds low; pull axe blade free; straighten and restore grip; ready. Airborne frames4-6 one-based. Cracked ground as small floating effect beneath feet only, no actual scenery; keep clear face even on downward motion, axe and rock debris contained with margins. No generic fire tornado.
